_comment: Phase 5.1 cosmetic personas: name, portrait (assets/ui/portraits/<id>.svg, drawn by scripts/art/gen_portraits.py), signature colour and a one-line bio. Presentation only: no rules data, no ability, no bonus. 'pawn' is the preferred pawn colour (0 red, 1 blue, 2 green, 3 orange); the player may change it.
